latestVersion.changelog:
Image to Video Converter AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly converts up to 10 JPG product photos into 1080p animated MP4 or other video formats with a simple prompt.
- Fully automated cloud backend setup: automatic token and session management, with 100 free render credits per new user.
- Drag-and-drop upload and text-based instructions—no timeline editing or export settings needed.
- Fast AI-powered rendering (30–90 sec per video), supporting smooth transitions, aspect ratios, and text/audio overlays via user prompt.
- Easy access to balance/credits, project status, and exports; robust error handling and guided actions.
- Supports common media formats: mp4, mov, webm, avi, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
